chars.N: NARRATOR: a skinny young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, grey sweatpants and black plastic slippers.
chars.L: LANDLADY: a plump middle-aged woman wearing a purple leopard-print satin dressing gown, a pink headscarf tied on top of her head and many gold bangles.
chars.G: TWO ROWDY GUESTS: a big-bellied man in a shiny red tracksuit and a tall man in a white tank top with a thick gold chain, both tipsy and loud.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, the tiled inner courtyard of an old Moroccan house in Temara with many room doors. The LANDLADY argues loudly with the TWO ROWDY GUESTS who wave their arms, while the NARRATOR peeks out from a half-open small door on the side, shocked. Comic awkward mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A tiny bare rented room with peeling green paint and a thin mattress on the floor. The NARRATOR lies on the mattress pressing a pillow over his head, exhausted and annoyed, at night, a bare light bulb.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The old wooden front door of a Moroccan house at night. The LANDLADY, smiling widely, welcomes the TWO ROWDY GUESTS who arrive carrying plastic bags and a speaker, grinning. Warm doorway light, dark street behind.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A narrow old street in Temara at night. Several neighbours in pyjamas and djellabas stand at their doors and balconies looking annoyed and pointing at one house. The NARRATOR is among them in the middle, embarrassed, hands on his head.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The tiled courtyard of the old house at night. The TWO ROWDY GUESTS push and shove each other in a clumsy comic scuffle, a plastic chair knocked over, while the LANDLADY tries to pull them apart, shouting. Cartoon comedy, no blood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside the tiny rented room at night. The NARRATOR presses his back against his locked wooden door, eyes wide and scared, sweat drops, his backpack on the floor beside him.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: View from inside a small room: the NARRATOR peers out of a small barred window at the back of the house, shocked. Outside in the dark street below, a Moroccan police car with flashing blue lights arrives and police officers in dark blue uniforms get out.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of the NARRATOR in his tiny room at night, panicking, both hands on his cheeks, mouth open, sweat flying, blue police lights flashing through the small window behind him.
